'''Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court''' is the eighth of the [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|numbered Virtual Sets]] the [[Players Committee]] released between 2002 and 2009. Each of its 50 cards is a printed slip that replaces the bottom half of a [[Decipher]] card. The slip gives new game text, stats and icons; the title, lore and art stay as printed. The Committee released it on 24 November 2004.<ref name="legal" /> In December 2006 the Committee reissued it as a ''Remaster'' sheet with new pack art, a set symbol and the final text.<ref name="ia" />

The Remaster column sets each slip onto its printed Decipher card, re-typeset at 600 DPI in the style of the Committee's later Holotable cards. They were made for the wiki in 2026 and are fan reconstructions, not Committee products (see [[Typography of Star Wars CCG cards]]). Game text is written out in full where the slips use the icon shorthand explained at [[Virtual card icons]].

== Printings ==
The Committee re-edited the Remaster sheet on 25 June 2007 with errata to [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|Careful Planning (V)]] (#5) and [[Combat Readiness (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|Combat Readiness (V)]] (#30).<ref name="ia" /> It re-edited it again on 17 September 2007 with errata to [[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|Tusken Breath Mask (V)]] (#22).<ref name="ia" /> In the [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization|2009 reorganisation]] the Committee regrouped these cards into the [[:Category:Virtual Legacy sets|Virtual Blocks]].<ref name="reorg2009">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090918131415/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org] (Internet Archive, 18 September 2009): the Players Committee realigned Virtual Sets 1–18 into thematic Virtual Blocks.</ref> Some returned in the [[:Category:Current Virtual sets|Virtual Sets]] released after the 2014 Reset with the same or revised game text.
